title: bamboo table
text: bamboo table. This is a temporary table for me as I wait for my custom piece to be finished... so it doesn't match my decor very well, but it is totally functional.  Went together fairly easily.  Took me about 20 minutes to assemble.  You get the parts and an allen wrench to complete the project.  It looks like bamboo... it's very smooth - no sharp edges or splinters that can be an issue with sharp edged bamboo products. Overall I like bamboo- it's renewable.  They give you extra screws - one long one short and a nubbin. HINT:  I always rebag extra parts AND the tool(s) with instructions on the bottom of whatever the item is.  This makes it easy to find if you need to repair or disassemble easily.  I also note the date and place of my purchase in case I need to review that for some reason.  Just a thought.  That process has worked out so well for me!  The table has some weight, but it is NOT super heavy - meaning it is easy to move it when you need to.  I've included photos - the first one is the table top.. the second shows the side, then instructions, tools and bits, extras, my "tape-extras-under-the-table" trick and last the completed table.  I hope it helps in your purchase decision.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
